name: BCL10 immune signaling adaptor
pathways: regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction

function.text: BCL10 encodes b-cell lymphoma/leukemia 10. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coactivator activity and general transcription initiation factor binding. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction.

function.text: BCL10 encodes b-cell lymphoma/leukemia 10. It contributes to both adaptive and innate immune signaling by bridging CARD domain-containing proteins to immune activation. It acts by channeling adaptive and innate immune signaling downstream of CARD domain-containing proteins CARD9, CARD11 and CARD14 to activate NF-kappa-B and MAP kinase p38 (MAPK11, MAPK12, MAPK13 and/or MAPK14) pathways which stimulate expression of genes encoding pro-inflammatory cytokines and chemokines. It promotes apoptosis, pro-caspase-9 maturation and activation of NF-kappa-B via NIK and IKK.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with immunodeficiency 37 (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving BCL10 have been reported in marginal zone lymphoma, malignant lymphoma, and diffuse large b-Cell lymphoma, NOS.
